tenders.category: Building demolition and wrecking work and earthmoving work; Site preparation work; Engineering works and construction works; Transport by pipeline of natural gas; Pipeline transport services;
tenders.eligibility: Eligibility of Tenderer:- Procurement Works for Pigging and Hydrostatic Test of 6''x1000 PSIG 26.32 KM Gas Transmission Pipeline from Rupganj Gas Field to Kamta Gas Field to Joydebpur CGS 1. The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in Government / Semi-government / autonomous body or under any project financed/ invested by the foreign agencies as Prime Contractor/Sub Contractor/ Third Party shall be 05 (five) years. (Years counting backward from the date of publication of IFT in the newspaper) 2. The required specific experience shall be demonstrated in the work through the successful completion of 01 (one) no contract of construction  or rehabiliation related work in transmission pipeline as 1.4 enlisted contractor under Petrobangla & its Companies over the last five (5) years, with a contract value of not less than BDT 40 (Forty) Lakh. The related evidences must be submitted along with the tender (Years counting backward from the date of publication of IFT in the newspaper) 3. The required average annual turnover of the Tenderer shall be greater than Tk. 100 (Hundred) lakh over the best 03 years from last 05 years.
tenders.briefDescription: Brief Description of Works:- Procurement Works for Pigging and Hydrostatic Test of 6''x1000 PSIG 26.32 KM Gas Transmission Pipeline from Rupganj Gas Field to Kamta Gas Field to Joydebpur CGS as follows: a) Preparation of Pigging Works b) Initial Pigging, and Condensate Management c) Water Management, and Hydrostatic testing d) Tie-In and Final Pigging of Pipeline e) Leakage Repair and Others related hydrostatic works (if leakage found) f) Commissioning and Documentation g) Related works & services.

(b) Specific experience: Having experiences in successfully completing of similar nature works amounting minimum of Taka 5.0 lac of Government/ Semi-Government sector in a single tender during the last 03 years The above experiences/work certificate for successful completion of similar nature works shall have to be issued by: (i) In case of the work done under any PWD Division, the certifying and authenticating authority shall be the concerned Executive Engineer. (ii) In case of the work done under any Govt/Semi Govt/ Other than PWD the certifying authority shall be an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer and the same duly verified by the concerned Executive Engineer of PWD of that district/area within whose jurisdiction work has been done. (c) Average annual construction turnover during the last five years in Taka 5.0 lac. (d) .iThe minimum amount of Liquid Assets or Working Capital or Credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Taka 5.0lac. [ Letter of Credit Commitment for Bank’s undertaking for Line of Credit (Form PW2A-8)] issued not earlier than twenty-eight (28) days before the day of the original deadline for submission of Tender is allowed]. (d) .ii The minimum Tender Capacity in Taka 5.0 lac (e) Updated Trade license, Income Tax clearance Certificate from NBR, and VAT Registration Certificate. (f) Updated ABC Electric contractor license and Electric supervisory license from the Electric licensing board, Government of Bangladesh (g)All Other qualifications, Terms & Conditions described in Tender documents and Tender Datasheet (TDS). Necessary supporting documents are to be submitted with the tender.
